Strategy: Raise the count-gated sweet-band reward to twenty-five while keeping the mid penalty at twenty, testing whether a slightly stronger pull toward residuals between thirty and forty-five improves on the champion. This may sharpen the preference for reusable leftovers, but the larger bonus may override tight fits.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
